about: Candidates examined and not listed, with the reason. Kept for transparency and future review; not published.

rejected.name: Strike
rejected.reason: Supports USDT deposits/withdrawals (TRON) in several countries.

rejected.name: Casa
rejected.reason: Offers Ethereum vaults; supports BTC, ETH, USDT and USDC.

rejected.name: Foundation Devices
rejected.reason: Passport Core (Bitcoin-only) discontinued; Passport Prime supports Ethereum and Solana assets via Legacy Mode.

rejected.name: Blockstream
rejected.reason: Green/Blockstream app and Jade support Liquid issued assets including USDt; also runs Liquid asset issuance.

rejected.name: BitBox (Shift Crypto)
rejected.reason: Sells a Multi edition supporting Ethereum/ERC-20, Litecoin and Cardano alongside the Bitcoin-only edition.

rejected.name: Trezor
rejected.reason: Universal firmware supports Ethereum, Solana and thousands of tokens; Bitcoin-only firmware is optional.

rejected.name: Ledger
rejected.reason: Supports ~15,000 coins and tokens including ETH, SOL, USDT, USDC.

rejected.name: Kraken
rejected.reason: Multi-asset exchange listing hundreds of cryptocurrencies.

rejected.name: Coinbase
rejected.reason: Multi-asset exchange (ETH, SOL, USDC, XRP, etc.).

rejected.name: Bitvavo
rejected.reason: Lists 400+ crypto assets.

rejected.name: Hodl Hodl
rejected.reason: Lending product (Lend at Hodl Hodl) disburses stablecoins (USDT, USDC) and other assets such as WBTC/XAUT.

rejected.name: BTCPay Server
rejected.reason: Official FAQ says it accepts Bitcoin and altcoins (altcoin support via plugins); also a community project rather than a company.

rejected.name: Start9
rejected.reason: StartOS marketplace includes a Monero full node package; general-purpose self-hosting OS.

rejected.name: Umbrel
rejected.reason: Official Umbrel App Store lists a Monero Node app in its Crypto category; general home-server OS.

rejected.name: Breez
rejected.reason: Breez SDK (Liquid) supports USDT; Breez SDK (Spark) supports sending/receiving USDC/USDT across many chains.

rejected.name: Blink
rejected.reason: Non-custodial mode Dollar Balance uses the USDB stablecoin (Brale) on Spark.

rejected.name: Wallet of Satoshi
rejected.reason: USD balance is the USDB stablecoin on Spark; homepage mentions USDC/USDT deposits.

rejected.name: Voltage
rejected.reason: Announced stablecoin payments (BitGo partnership; stablecoin support on roadmap) - not Bitcoin-only by positioning.

rejected.name: Fedi
rejected.reason: Borderline: Bitcoin/Fedimint wallet, but offers a 'Stable Balance' fixed-fiat-value feature (bitcoin-backed synthetic USD, not a stablecoin token). Excluded under 'when unsure, exclude'.

rejected.name: Coinos
rejected.reason: Corporate site says Liquid support adds 'the ability to manage assets and NFTs'.

rejected.name: Lendasat
rejected.reason: Bitcoin-backed loans paid out in USDC/USDT on Polygon, Ethereum, Solana, Starknet, Liquid; LendaSwap BTC<->stablecoin swaps.

rejected.name: Satora
rejected.reason: Formerly Lendasat/Lendaswap; non-custodial BTC<->stablecoin swap protocol incl. Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, USDC (CCTP).

rejected.name: Firefish
rejected.reason: Bitcoin-backed loans also disbursed in USDT and USDC.

rejected.name: Bitcoin Keeper
rejected.reason: Terms: services are for Bitcoin (BTC) and USDT (TRC-20); app has a USDT wallet.

rejected.name: Bipa
rejected.reason: Brazilian app also offers 'digital dollar' / USDT.

rejected.name: Amboss
rejected.reason: Payments API sends/receives USDT and USDC over Lightning (Taproot Assets).

rejected.name: Pleb.fi
rejected.reason: A Bitcoin developer hackathon/event series, not a company or product; no official site verified.

rejected.name: Primal
rejected.reason: Primarily a Nostr social client with a built-in Lightning wallet; could not verify an official Bitcoin-only statement (only pricing page found).

rejected.name: Bitkit (Synonym)
rejected.reason: Could not verify: Bitcoin/Lightning wallet, but no explicit Bitcoin-only statement found; Synonym also builds non-wallet products (Pubky).

rejected.name: Pouch.ph
rejected.reason: Could not verify Bitcoin-only status from official pages (only BTC/PHP pricing found).

rejected.name: Amber (AmberApp)
rejected.reason: Could not verify an explicit Bitcoin-only statement; AmberWallet new downloads paused.
